text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Dammit! I was one step away!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The top spot coulda been mine... The
hell's wrong
with me?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What kinda lukewarm comment izzat? I'll
never
be able to shine on the grand
stage thinkin' like
that!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
We're not gonna leave here pattin'
ourselves on
the back! Ya hear? Get
movin' 'n' set up a review
session!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go splash some cold water on
my face
to get my head back in the
game.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That goes without sayin'! I won't relive
this
disappointment ever again!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I really gotta blow 'em away in the next
race!
Yeah, a bang big and bright
enough to make up
for today!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So what're we still doin' here? Let's hurry
back!
